title: Functional Limits and Multiplier Bootstrap for Augmented QTE Processes at Critical Overlap
banked_reason: D0.5.G: paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < field threshold 7.4; fixed-chart process package is subfield and not salvageable in scope.
gap_reasons: The delivered contribution is an estimator-specific functional limit, simultaneous band, and squared-supremum risk limit within one known scalar triangular propensity experiment.
The package supplies no numerical evaluation of the prescribed projection, transport tuning, or band coverage, leaving its practical performance claims supported only asymptotically.
Panel findings left unrepaired (the tier, not these, is the reason for the halt): closest-comparator-omitted@thm:multiplier-band, closest-comparator-mischaracterized@thm:compact-process-uniform-risk.
proof_attempt_summary: The scalar sharp-constant proposal duplicated nearby work, so discovery pivoted to a compact-index augmented QTE process and removed an unsound optional endpoint extension. Stage 0 derived the functional limit, multiplier band, and squared-supremum risk result; the math panel passed with no findings. D0.5.G capped the fixed-chart contribution at subfield, below the field floor, with no in-scope improvement directive; a future field-tier attempt needs a new research anchor.
tldr: The proposal proves uniform weak convergence of the total two-fold transported augmented QTE root on the fixed compact rank interval at the critical \(\sqrt{\log n/n}\) scale, with a density-rescaled boundary-time-changed Brownian bridge and explicit off-diagonal covariance. The multiplier proof now controls the same-sample quantile substitution and cross-fitted nuisance substitution through two-index squared product classes, derives a quantitative empirical-\(L^2\) modulus whose remainder is summable through every conditional Gaussian dyadic level and the terminal scale, and proves uniform anti-concentration by the atomless Ornstein--Uhlenbeck supremum over a compact interval family. The resulting data-only process yields a simultaneous ninety-percent band. Separate repaired-root crossing tails give uniform third moments and convergence of squared-supremum risk on every fixed nonempty strict-slack class.
gap: Weak-overlap QTE theory supplies finite-dimensional heavy-tail limits, while full quantile-process and multiplier results assume strict overlap. Neither line identifies the augmented critical off-diagonal kernel or proves a simultaneous band under the logarithmically growing inverse-weight envelope.
fill: The project proves uniform covariance reduction, nondegeneracy and canonical-metric control of the kernel, rare-score asymptotic equicontinuity, quantile inversion in \(\ell^\infty(\mathcal T)\), consistent estimation of the entire kernel, and conditional multiplier validity for an honest QTE band built from total measurable finite-sample objects.
